solar.source: Illustrative absorbed indoor solar: 06:00-18:00 triangle, 600 W noon peak, 3.6 kWh/day; half to floor, remaining half equally to walls/roof. No irradiance/optics/weather validation.

controller_fallback.source: Only if no A/B case reaches 21 degC: separate illustrative controller probe, not a successful baseline or one-factor comparison. If this still fails to switch, report blocked without automatic escalation.

notes: All cases preserve the frozen C3.4 baseline file and use new generated workspaces.
UA changes do not change water/metal mass or nominal mass flow.
Native cumulative energy states remain the energy source; trace interpolation is only for time/temperature metrics.
Maximum-step sensitivity is reported as measured differences, not automatically declared converged.
